name: Private APIM AI Gateway
summary: APIM (AI Gateway) instance exposed via Private Endpoint.
description: APIM private endpoint routing puts the AI Gateway behind private DNS and TLS while Foundry forwards BYOM model calls to it. This confirms users can keep the gateway private and still route `{connection}/{deployment}` traffic from a private Foundry project.
notes:
Verified end-to-end through the private APIM endpoint. Docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/api-management/private-endpoint.

The validation is implicit in the live feature tests that route through APIM from the private VNet.
